title: pipe_popover_anchor indexes node_pos without checking node_slot's ok — safe only via an implicit invariant
detail: New shared function (delta) reads node_pos[sa]/node_pos[sb] with the ok from node_slot discarded; the only caller (popover_demolish_hit, exec.odin:455) guards with pipe_slot ok first, so a live pipe implies live endpoints (E27 batch keeps it consistent) and no OOB occurs today. Verbatim move of the removed app-side pipe_anchor — no behavior drift.
recommended_fix: Check the returned bool from both node_slot calls and return a zero vector (or early-false) on failure, so the latent OOB read cannot trigger if a future caller skips the pipe_slot guard.
